content: {"like":["Values authenticity and relatability in media, especially shows that reflect real-life experiences;","Prefers high-energy, action-packed content with surprising twists and a wide range of engaging characters;","Appreciates strong vocal talent and catchy opening music that set a memorable tone;","Enjoys original and funny storytelling that stands out as a bright spot amid mediocre offerings;","Seeks comprehensive, well-packaged collections that include special features and are region-compatible"],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly paced or convoluted narratives that lose focus and become confusing;","Criticizes low-quality production and manufacturing issues that affect viewing experience;","Finds certain shows or characters lacking depth or maturity, especially when targeted at younger audiences;","Rejects incomplete or fragmented releases that force separate purchases or exclude key content;","Shows frustration with content that feels like a decline or jump‑shark, leading to disappointment and lack of originality"]}
